lead.headline: Changes to high-risk medical devices filed as 30-day notices, skipping full FDA review, rose from 19% to 64%
lead.number: 19% of approval changes in 2000-04 to 64% from 2010 on; one Medtronic defibrillator line (P980016) has 928 changes, 621 of them 30-day notices.
lead.watch_out: No skeptic has checked it; long-lived pacemaker and defibrillator lines pile up manufacturing changes, and the device-problem reports here cover only 2020-01 to 2021-09.

sources.page_context: The researchers analyzed 373 devices that received PMAs between 2008 and 2019. Manufacturers filed 10,766 supplements in relation to the devices. The analysis showed that devices with more supplements were more likely to be recalled. Each increase of one supplement a year raised the risk of recall. Almost all, 99%, of the supplements were filed without clinical data.
